text_block_list.text:
That day, upon Chairwoman Akikawa's 
orders, I headed to a buffet-style party 
for racing affiliates, attended by 
numerous prominent figures.

I feel completely out of place...! As I 
look around restlessly—

text_block_list.name: Glamorous Lady
text_block_list.text:
My goodness, if it isn't the lady from 
that "Illustrious Clan"...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I am Daiichi Ruby. It is an honor to 
make your acquaintance.

A horse girl born into a distinguished 
lineage known by all: Daiichi Ruby. She 
seems to be attending the party due to 
family obligations or something similar.

text_block_list.name: Bearded Gentleman
text_block_list.text:
There isn't a soul in this venue who 
doesn't know of you. Though, for someone 
as unknown as myself to address you, I 
might merely be an inconvenience...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
You are too modest. You are the managing 
director of the sportswear company that 
designed the uniforms for the Italian club 
team, are you not?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—It has been a long time. Allow me to 
express my gratitude for your unchanging 
patronage and goodwill ever since my 
grandmother's active racing days.

Surrounded by prominent figures of the 
industry, Daiichi Ruby held her ground 
without the slightest hesitation, carrying 
on the conversation with effortless grace.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Gentleman
text_block_list.text:
My word, you truly bear your grandmother's 
likeness. It brings back fond memories of 
those days—

text_block_list.name: Elderly Gentleman
text_block_list.text:
When she received her second URA Award, I 
remember thinking, "Ah, of course she 
did."

text_block_list.name: Bearded Gentleman
text_block_list.text:
And then, Ruby-san, your mother claimed a 
record-setting victory in her debut 
race... what a thrill that was. It felt 
like the return of a legend!

text_block_list.name: Glamorous Lady
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, indeed! Following that, her 
spectacular feats on the Tiara route... 
receiving the URA Award was only natural!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Hearing you say so is the highest honor. 
My mother and grandmother are the pride of 
our clan, and figures I strive to emulate.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Gentleman
text_block_list.text:
Ah, in any case, I am truly looking 
forward to it! After all, your mother's 
great triumphs were equal to, if not 
greater than, your grandmother's.

text_block_list.name: Bearded Gentleman
text_block_list.text:
In that case, Ruby-san's triumphs will 
surely elevate the Illustrious Clan to 
even greater heights! Forgive me, but I 
hold tremendous expectations for you!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes. Unworthy though I may be—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I shall devote every ounce of my strength 
to never betray the expectations of 
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, I will be returning directly to the 
academy. Then, let us proceed accordingly.

A short while later. Stepping out into the 
hallway to return to the venue from the 
restroom, I spot Daiichi Ruby on the 
phone.

She had absorbed all those expectant words 
from the crowd with utter composure. Her 
unbothered, blank expression oddly weighs 
on my mind.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...? In what regard? Was there some 
impropriety in my conduct?

Doesn't the weight of people's 
expectations burden her? Doesn't she feel 
pressured...? Clumsily, I convey my 
concern.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for your consideration. 
However, the expectations placed upon me 
are expectations for the clan. There is no 
reason for me to consider them a burden.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Please, return to the hall. As a trainer 
of the academy, there must be many people 
you should speak with rather than someone 
like myself.
choice_data_list:
To tell the truth, I don't know who is 
who...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I see. If that is the case—

Daiichi Ruby taught me which key figures I 
ought to greet. Her knowledge of 
professional networking far exceeds my own 
as an adult...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Not at all. Now, if you will excuse me.

Daiichi Ruby walks back toward the venue 
with steady, unhesitating steps. Her back 
is perfectly straight, yet so small—

It seemed far too delicate to bear the 
weight of all those immense expectations. 
That was the impression left on me.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for your consideration. 
However, the expectations placed upon me 
are expectations for the clan. There is no 
reason for me to consider them a burden.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If I appeared helpless or adrift to you, 
then that is merely a reflection of my own 
inadequacy.
choice_data_list: No, that's not what I meant...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for causing you concern. Now, 
if you will excuse me.

Daiichi Ruby walks back toward the venue 
with steady, unhesitating steps. Her back 
is perfectly straight, yet so small—

It seemed far too delicate to bear the 
weight of all those immense expectations. 
That was the impression left on me.
